findings.title: Start fresh enables optional faith/history collections
findings.evidence: startFresh restores emptySave with migrateLibrary default existingLearners=true. Read-only execution yields both faith and island-history; fresh startup with existingLearners=false yields neither.
findings.requiredCorrection: Migrate the reset payload with existingLearners:false before passing it to restore, e.g. restore(JSON.stringify(migrateLibrary(emptySave(), { existingLearners:false }))). Keep restore preservation path. Add a Store startFresh regression checking both collections off, preservation, and reload.

findings.title: War-survival art shows standing figures against the exact seated alt
findings.evidence: Exact image.alt/artBrief.exactAlt says the storyteller and child sit beside an album. Both SVG people have the standing straight-leg path M-9 66 L-11 94 M10 66 L12 94, with no seats. Opened final sheet visibly confirms the mismatch.
findings.requiredCorrection: Redraw the older storyteller and listening child in unmistakably seated poses beside the album, preserving the exact alt/artBrief pair. Update image hash in canonical/source records, regenerate affected art sheet and versioned delta. Independently re-open the changed render.
